rules.desc: Windows Firewall should be enabled (at least one firewall product/state=On)
rules.query: SELECT name, state, type FROM windows_security_products WHERE type = 'Firewall' LIMIT 5;
rules.lua:
if #results == 0 then return false end
for i=1,#results do
  local s = results[i].state or ""
  s = string.lower(tostring(s))
  if s == "on" or s == "1" or tonumber(s) == 1 then return true end
end
return false

rules.query: SELECT name, state, signatures_up_to_date, type FROM windows_security_products WHERE type = 'Antivirus' LIMIT 10;
rules.lua:
if #results == 0 then return false end
for i=1,#results do
  local s = results[i].state or ""
  s = string.lower(tostring(s))
  if s == "on" or s == "1" or tonumber(s) == 1 then return true end
  -- fallback: treat signature presence as a sign of an installed AV
  local sig = results[i].signatures_up_to_date or ""
  if sig == "1" or tonumber(sig) == 1 then return true end
end
return false

rules.desc: Windows Security Center overall status (firewall/antivirus should be Good)
rules.query: SELECT antivirus, firewall, autoupdate FROM windows_security_center LIMIT 1;
rules.lua:
if #results == 0 then return false end
local r = results[1]
local function ok(val)
  if val == nil then return false end
  local s = string.lower(tostring(val))
  return s == "good" or s == "on" or s == "1" or tonumber(s) and tonumber(s) ~= 0
end
return ok(r.antivirus) and ok(r.firewall)
